caption:
Stop performing. Nobody is watching. 🎥

If you want to make real money on social media, tattoo this on your forehead:

You're not performing for an audience.
You're on a one-way, infinite FaceTime call with ONE person… who has their camera off.

So stop talking to "everyone."
Talk to the one customer on the other side of the screen.
